items.name: Breath of Silt
items.text:
30 feet. A creature that begins its turn within the area feels as if its lungs are filling with silt and must succeed at a DC 25 Fortitude save save or be unable to speak or breathe. The creature can still hold its breath and can attempt a new saving throw at the end of its turn.

A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune to breath of silt for 24 hours.

items.name: Rise Up
items.text:
Trigger A creature walks on top of the bog mummy amalgamation lying buried in the silt below

Requirements Initiative has not yet been rolled

---

Effect The bog mummy amalgamation notices the creature automatically and Burrows before rolling initiative.

items.name: Bog Rot
items.text:
This affliction can't be reduced below stage 1, nor can the damage from it be healed, until it's successfully treated with Cleanse Affliction or a similar effect; the affliction can then be removed as normal for a disease.

A creature killed by bog rot melts into a noxious sludge and can't be resurrected except by a 7th-rank Resurrect ritual or similar magic

Saving Throw DC 21 Fortitude save

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 minute)

Stage 2 3d6 void damage and Clumsy 1 (1 day).

items.name: Fist Flurry
items.text: The amalgamation makes two fist Strikes against two different targets within its reach. Its multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks.
